bot.start:
Hi, {name}! 👋

I'm **SDU Hub**, your student-life assistant.

💬 **Just write what you need**, for example:
“What is my grade in discrete math?”
“Is there a free room tomorrow at 14:00?”
“When does withdrawal end?”

Or use the buttons under the message field 👇

/account — sign in or unlink your accounts
/lang — Қазақша / Русский / English
/help — help
bot.help:
**SDU Hub · Help**

💬 You don't need commands: just ask in your own words. I can show:
📊 your grades, also for one course
📅 Moodle deadlines
🚪 free rooms for a time you choose
🎉 campus events
📆 academic calendar dates
📚 the course registration guide
📄 enrollment documents

**Commands**
/start — main menu
/account — sign in, link Moodle or unlink
/lang — Қазақша / Русский / English
/help — this help

During a sign-in, /cancel stops it. “🆕 New chat” below clears the AI conversation.
bot.lang_set: Language switched to English. Go ahead and ask.
bot.reset: Conversation history cleared. You can ask a new question.
bot.not_text: I only understand text for now. Please type your question.
bot.guide_short:
📚 **How to create your schedule (course registration)**

1. **Check the dates.** my.sdu.edu.kz → Information → System Calendar, row “Course Registration”. Your own window is in Individual Permissions.
2. **Plan ahead.** My Curriculum shows your courses; agree on them with your advisor. You can save them in the Wish list.
3. **Register.** When the window opens: Academic Operations → Course Registration. For each course choose the N (lecture) section, then its P and L sections, and press add.
4. **Confirm.** Press the confirmation button: the status becomes STUDENT CONFIRMED, then APPROVED.
5. **Limits.** 20–40 ECTS per semester, 30 recommended. A course without registration gives no credit.

After registration you can still change courses in Add-Drop (the first week of classes), with paid late registration, or by withdrawal.

📄 Every step, the timetable colors and the portal's messages are in the full guide: tap the button below.
bot.guide_file_caption: 📄 The full course registration guide (in English).
